scope: Additional independent Opus 5 cross-repo findings added after c17_cert_contract_opus5_followup_prediction.json was committed. This artifact is committed before implementing these newly scoped changes.

no_git_provenance.producer: A producer run from an image without .git succeeds only when pokezero.audit_provenance.public_repo_commit or an explicit injected public commit resolves to a valid SHA; it fails closed when neither source is available.
no_git_provenance.readout: Runtime and checkout provenance use the same public commit resolver; a resolved commit that differs from the final contract remains a gate failure.
no_git_provenance.test: Mocking raw git failure while injecting a valid public commit permits valid producer/readout provenance; no injected commit produces an explicit failure.

final_contract_schema.producer: The bounded v2 manifest producer rejects a final contract missing or malformed requires_execution_contract, required_image_commit, rate tables, predicted class rates, or a producer-script hash when the contract declares one.
final_contract_schema.consumer: The readout validates the same final-contract field set and rejects a manifest whose producer hash differs from the contract's declared producer hash.
final_contract_schema.agreement: A valid final-contract fixture passes both producer-side and readout-side validation without introducing private-only fields.

non_goals: No private deployment metadata or family-table format is added to the public schema.
No existing zero-unattributed, predicted-zero, or upper-rate gate is weakened.
